body: Hi Nicole, we received your application for the Backend Engineer role. Our team will review it and reach out if there is a match.

subject: Next steps

subject: Update on your application

subject: Thank you for your interest in Company D
body: We appreciate your interest in opportunities at Company D. Your profile has been added to our talent community.

expect.reason: no application matches; talent-community blast is not a confirmation

note: must land in review, not the database

subject: Re: Software Engineer
body: Following up on my last note about the Software Engineer role -- also wanted to flag we have a Platform Engineer opening you may prefer.

expect.reason: ambiguous between two roles at same company

note: two-role ambiguity; fuzzy match must refuse rather than pick

subject: Invitation: Technical Interview @ Thu Sep 3
